title: Bortle Dark-Sky Scale Reference (Classes 1 to 9)
description: Reference data for building the guided Star-Count Test in Track 1 (AstroGaze).

classes.label: Excellent Dark-Sky Site
classes.milky_way: Casts noticeable shadows on the ground; zodiacal light and gegenschein visible.
classes.m31_andromeda: Clearly visible to the naked eye.

classes.label: Typical Truly Dark Site
classes.milky_way: Highly structured summer Milky Way; clouds appear as dark holes against stars.
classes.m31_andromeda: Easily visible to the naked eye.

classes.label: Rural Sky
classes.milky_way: Still appears complex; minor light domes visible on the horizon.

classes.label: Rural / Suburban Transition
classes.milky_way: Impressive overhead, but lacks structure near the horizon.

classes.label: Suburban Sky
classes.milky_way: Washed out near the horizon; faint overhead.

classes.label: Inner-City Sky
classes.milky_way: Invisible; only Moon, planets, and brightest stars visible.
